title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-130-25二模

items.zh: 比起看恐怖电影,他更喜欢读武侠小说。
items.en: He prefers reading wuxia novels to watching horror movies.

items.zh: 日常用品价格涨得越高,人们的生活压力就越大。
items.en: The higher the prices of everyday items are, the greater the pressure on people’s lives becomes.

items.zh: 孩子们不愿做作业却愿意花太多时间在社交媒体上,家长为此感到很担心。当下这种情况很普遍。
items.en: Nowadays it is common that children are unwilling to do their homework but willing to spend too much time on social media, which greatly worries their parents.

items.zh: 虽然学校餐厅人潮拥挤,但排队的队伍井然有序,学生们打好饭都能找到一张桌子坐下来用餐。
items.en: Despite the crowds in the school canteen, the queues are in good order, and students can find a table to eat at after getting their food.
